Jeera Rice Recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Sunday, May 27, 2018 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




2 teaspoons Cumin seeds
2 to 3 tablespoons Ghee
2 inch Cinnamon stick
8 to 10 pieces Black peppercorn
4 to 5 pieces cloves
Chopped coriander

Preparation

1 In a pan add in oil, cumin seeds, coriander, fresh cream, rice, salt and mix it all together. 2 Garnish it with few coriander leaves and mix it again 3 Jeera rice is ready to serve.

About

Learn how to make Jeera Rice at home with Minimal Ingredients like Cumin seeds, Ghee, Cinnamon stick, Black peppercorn, cloves, Chopped coriander and main ingredient Rice. Jeera Rice goes well with any curry or Gravy Recipe. Jeera Rice is one of the most popular rice dishes in restaurants.
